description: auth + store examples (4 files), all Live. Demonstrate the stdlib authenticators and the AuthenticationInterface extension point, plus the StorageBackend core backends and a custom backend. Independent of the other FEATs (shares the one worktree; runs sequentially). Read .agents/tasks/example-coverage/context.json and this file FIRST; exact signatures are in .agents/tasks/example-coverage/plan.md Digest.
steps: Create examples/auth/credential_sources.py (Live). From skye.auth.aws construct BedrockApiKeyAuthenticator(api_key='demo') and SigV4Authenticator(region='us-east-1', service='bedrock', credentials=AwsCredentials(access_key='AKIA...', secret_key='secret')); call .apply('GET', 'https://bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/', {}) and print the returned header names (not secret values). Mention env/file/IMDS resolution via CredentialProvider but pass explicit/static creds so no metadata call fires (IMDS is refused by the fake). main() + guard.

Create examples/auth/custom_credential_source.py (Live). Define a user class implementing skye.base.interfaces.authentication.AuthenticationInterface (apply(method, url, headers, body=b'')->dict[str,str]) that adds an Authorization header; assert isinstance(obj, AuthenticationInterface) (runtime-checkable Protocol) and print the resulting headers.

Create examples/store/backends.py (Live). Use asyncio.run(main()). Exercise InMemoryBackend and FileSystemBackend (core) end to end: connect, set(key, {...}), get(key), increment(key), get_multiple([...]). For DynamoDBBackend/RedisBackend/PostgreSQLBackend, construct inside try/except (ImportError, MissingExtraError) printing a short skip note (boto3/redis/asyncpg absent). Use tempfile for the FileSystemBackend path and clean it up.

Create examples/store/custom_backend.py (Live). Implement a new StorageBackend subclass backed by a dict (all abstract async methods: connect/get/set/increment/get_multiple/set_multiple) and exercise it with asyncio.run.
Run black and fix ruff on examples/auth and examples/store so both are clean.
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest tests/examples -q -k 'auth or store' passes
uv run ruff check examples/auth examples/store reports no errors
uv run black --check examples/auth examples/store reports nothing to reformat
No forbidden library imported at top level; optional store backends guarded; no secret values printed
Any temp file created by the FileSystem backend is removed
verification: uv run pytest tests/examples -q -k 'auth or store'
uv run ruff check examples/auth examples/store
findings: Created 4 Live examples: examples/auth/credential_sources.py, examples/auth/custom_credential_source.py, examples/store/backends.py, examples/store/custom_backend.py. Also added README entries for the new auth/ and store/ categories. Key facts for later steps: (1) AuthenticationInterface lives in skye.base.interfaces.authentication (runtime-checkable Protocol); apply(method, url, headers, body=b'') -> dict[str,str]. (2) skye.auth.aws exports AwsCredentials, BedrockApiKeyAuthenticator, SigV4Authenticator, CredentialProvider; .apply does crypto only (no network) and works offline with static AwsCredentials. (3) skye.store exports InMemoryBackend, FileSystemBackend (core) and DynamoDBBackend/RedisBackend/PostgreSQLBackend (optional). StorageBackend ABC is in skye.base.interfaces.storage (and re-exported from skye.base.interfaces); abstract async methods: connect/get/set/increment/get_multiple/set_multiple. DynamoDB/Redis/Postgres constructors do NOT import their lib at __init__ (lazy on connect), but guarded with (ImportError, MissingExtraError) per plan anyway. MissingExtraError importable from skye.base.exceptions (ImportError subclass). (4) FileSystemBackend uses base_path; example uses tempfile.TemporaryDirectory so nothing is left on disk. Only header NAMES are printed (sorted), never secret values. Verification: pytest tests/examples -k 'auth or store' = 8 passed; ruff check and black --check on examples/auth examples/store both clean.
